subject: Post-demo: privacy & DPA options for FinX
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@finx-pay.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: privacy & DPA options for FinX

Thanks again for taking time to join the demo this morning — appreciate the clear questions from the FinX team. Quick recap and a few asks so we can keep momentum on contracting/security.

TL;DR: You asked about SOC 2, data roles (controller vs processor), and which SCC/DPA path we recommend. Below is what we need from your side and what we'll prepare.

Summary from call:
- Redwood to be evaluated as the inference provider for payment risk scoring endpoints (no long-term storage of raw card data).
- Key compliance asks: GDPR DPA, EU SCC, SOC 2 evidence; potential HIPAA if PHI surfaces in xfer (not expected).

Items we need from you:
1) Confirm whether FinX will be the controller for the data sent to Redwood (my understanding is yes).
2) SOC 2 status and most recent report (or attest letter).
3) Which SCC module you prefer for a processor relationship (if you have legal precedent we should mirror it).
4) Please complete the attached security questionnaire (FinX_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) for our legal/security intake team.

What Redwood will provide by EOD Wed (Aug 12):
- A redlineable DPA tailored for a processor role (we'll attach a sample DPA for your legal team).
- Our SOC 2 status and policy summary; pointer to evidence under NDA if needed.
- Proposed mutual action plan with milestones and an optional HIPAA addendum template if you want it on the table.

Attachments: FinX_DPA_Request_Template.docx (please fill in contact/legal fields and return).

Next suggested steps:
- You confirm controller/processor alignment and upload the SOC2 evidence to the secure Drive link (or email security@finx-pay.com to coordinate).
- We'll send a DPA draft + SCC recommendation and schedule a 30-minute legal/security sync next week.

Thanks — I’ll loop in product security as soon as we have your questionnaire.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@finx-pay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finx-pay.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: privacy & DPA options for FinX

Thanks Connor — great demo and helpful summary. Quick answers below.

- Controller/Processor: FinX will be the data controller. We expect Redwood to act as a processor/sub-processor for the inference calls.
- SOC 2: FinX has a SOC 2 Type II report covering our production environment; most recent report completed Nov 2025. We can share the full report under NDA.
- SCC preference: our legal team usually requests the standard EU SCCs for processor-to-controller transfers (we've historically used the Module 2-equivalent mapping in our contracting). If you have a recommended module or template, please send it.

I've attached the security questionnaire you requested (FinX_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — our security team (security@finx-pay.com) will fill in the infra/network sections. Please send your DPA sample and any SCC language you prefer.

We also have a small HIPAA risk assessment to confirm (we do transmit limited user contact info in some flows) — not blocking but would like to review a HIPAA addendum if applicable.

Open items from our side:
- We will return the completed questionnaire by COB Thu (Aug 12).
- Please indicate whether Redwood requires sub-processor disclosure (we'll need that list for our legal).

Regards,
Laura Gibbs
Privacy Lead | FinX Payments
laura.gibbs@finx-pay.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@finx-pay.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-demo: privacy & DPA options for FinX

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround. Looping our legal/security owners so we can move the paperwork without back-and-forth.

A few notes from Redwood legal/security:
- Based on the controller=FinX / processor=Redwood alignment, we'll prepare a processor-first DPA. I'll attach our latest public sample (Redwood_DPA_Sample_v2.pdf) as a starting point.
- SCCs: Redwood typically proposes the standard EU SCC clauses for processor-to-controller transfers (we'll embed the compatible module text in the DPA draft). If FinX has redlines to a specific module, send them and we'll mirror to reduce cycles.
- Evidence: please share either the SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) or an access link under NDA. If you'd prefer, we can execute a short mutual NDA before exchange.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Thu Aug 12: FinX returns the completed security questionnaire + SOC2 report or NDA request.
2) Fri Aug 13: Redwood sends DPA draft with SCC module embedded + sub-processor list and HIPAA addendum template.
3) Mon Aug 16: Legal/security 30-min sync to resolve open redlines.
4) DocuSign execution target: Wed Aug 18.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Sample_v2.pdf (sample DPA), please review and flag must-haves for legal. We'll also add our sub-processor list to the Drive link.

Connor — if FinX returns the questionnaire by COB Thu we'll hit the Fri delivery target for the DPA draft.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Gibbs <laura.gibbs@finx-pay.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, security@finx-pay.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: privacy & DPA options for FinX (next steps)

Laura — thanks and appreciate your team's responsiveness. Confirming agreed next steps and proposed meeting: 

Agreed items:
- Controller: FinX; Processor: Redwood (confirmed).
- FinX to deliver completed FinX_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx and either SOC 2 Type II PDF or NDA request by COB Thu Aug 12 (per your note).
- Redwood to deliver DPA draft + SCC module suggestion + sub-processor disclosure by Fri Aug 13.

Ask: Can we schedule a 30-min legal/security sync on Fri Aug 13 at 10:00 AM BST / 02:00 AM PDT? If that doesn't work for FinX legal, propose Mon Aug 16 09:00 AM BST.

I'll also include a DocuSign pre-fill link once Rachel posts the DPA draft to Drive so you can preview suggested language before the call.

Quoted for context:
> Rachel: proposed mutual action plan with Fri delivery for DPA draft if questionnaire returned by Thu COB.

Thanks again — looking forward to wrapping this up swiftly.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
